_README: Service catalogue: what a UGBS student can ask for, who owns it, and what it takes.
Hand-transcribed from published sources. Fees, rooms and turnarounds here are
`documented: false` means we found no published procedure. The system still
routes the student to the right office, but it must NOT invent the steps. Those
services are what the knowledge-gap register on the dashboard is built to surface:
they are the real finding of this project, not a hole to be quietly filled in.

services.name: Request an official transcript
steps: Check that your academic record is correct on the student MIS portal before applying.
Submit the request and payment on the STS portal at https://sts.ug.edu.gh.
Track the status of the request on the same portal.
Collect when the request is marked Completed, or receive it at the email address you gave.

fees.mode: Physical copy, pick up at AAD
Physical copy, Post Office delivery within Ghana
fees.additional: GH₵25 each up to 10 copies; beyond 10 copies pick-up only

services.turnaround_note: Not stated for the standard service; track the request on the STS portal.

services.name: Request an express (same-day) transcript
services.channel: In person - Cash Office then Room D2
services.eligibility: Requests must be submitted before 11:00 AM.
steps: Submit the request before 11:00 AM - express requests are not available on the STS portal.
Pay at the Cash Office.
Submit the receipt at Room D2, Academic Affairs Directorate.

fees.mode: Express same-day, pick up at AAD

services.supersedes_note: The standard STS-portal route does not apply to this student, so offering it alongside would send them to a portal that will reject them.

services.name: Request a transcript for a pre-1996 graduate
services.channel: In person - Cash Office then Room D2
services.eligibility: Applies to students who graduated before 1996. They cannot use the STS portal.
steps: Do not use the STS portal - it does not cover pre-1996 graduates.
Pay for the transcript at the Cash Office.
Submit the receipt at Room D2, Academic Affairs Directorate for processing.
services.fees_note: The published rate table does not separate pre-1996 requests; confirm the amount at the Cash Office.
services.turnaround: Ready for collection within two weeks
services.supersedes_note: The standard STS-portal route does not apply to this student, so offering it alongside would send them to a portal that will reject them.

services.name: Request a graduate (postgraduate) transcript
services.channel: Email to the School of Graduate Studies
services.eligibility: Applies to graduate students. Graduate transcripts are processed by the School of Graduate Studies, not the AAD.
steps: Contact the School of Graduate Studies at sgstranscript@ug.edu.gh.
Graduate transcripts are processed there rather than at the Academic Affairs Directorate.
services.fees_note: Not published on the AAD rate table; confirm with the School of Graduate Studies.
services.supersedes_note: The standard STS-portal route does not apply to this student, so offering it alongside would send them to a portal that will reject them.

services.name: Collect a transcript on someone else's behalf
steps: Bring a letter of consent from the transcript owner.
Bring a valid ID card of the transcript owner.
Bring a valid ID card of the proxy, the person collecting.
Present all three documents at the time of collection.

services.name: Register as a fresh student
steps: Pay at least the required minimum of your academic fee.
Get your UG Student ID Number and UG 5-digit PIN from your provisional admission letter.
Activate your UG-assigned email account.
Log in to MIS Web and open Registration under the Student iEnabler.
Click Submit Registration, then the blue letters under Qualification Code, and select Register for This Qualification.
Click Save and Continue to view your selected courses.
Click Continue to view the registration cost, then Accept Registration to complete it.
Click Printer Friendly Format and print your proof of registration.
services.fees_note: Registration requires partial payment of academic fees; see the Schedule of Fees for your programme.

services.name: Register as a continuing student
steps: Pay the required portion of your academic fees for the semester.
Log in to MIS Web and complete course registration under the Student iEnabler.
Print your proof of registration once the registration is accepted.

services.name: Request a grade change
steps: Obtain the change of grade form from the Academic Affairs Directorate.
The request is initiated and endorsed by the teaching department, not by the student alone.

services.name: Find out what fees I have to pay
services.time_varying_note: Fees are republished every academic year. We hold one year only, so a question about any other year must be refused rather than answered from the year we have.
steps: Open the Schedule of Fees for your college and academic year.
UGBS students are in the College of Humanities, so use the College of Humanities fee schedule.
Fees differ for Ghanaian and international students, and by level and programme.
services.fees_note: Specific amounts are in the fee schedule document for the relevant academic year. The system quotes only the year it holds.

services.name: Find the examination timetable
aliases: when is the exam timetable released
steps: Open the examination timetable on the STS portal at https://sts.ug.edu.gh/timetable.

services.name: Defer a semester or academic year
aliases: what happens to my fees if I defer
steps: Obtain a deferment application form from the Academic Affairs Directorate or your department office.
Complete it, stating your grounds and the exact period you wish to defer.
Attach supporting documents — medical grounds need a report from the University Hospital or a recognised facility.
Have the form endorsed by your Head of Department.
Submit it to the Academic Affairs Directorate for a decision.
Collect the written approval and keep it; you need it to resume.
services.turnaround: A decision is normally communicated within four weeks
services.synthetic_note: Procedure authored by the project team. No published University source was found for it. Shown to students with a synthetic-source badge.
services.eligibility: A student in good standing, on documented grounds such as ill health, financial hardship or bereavement.

services.name: Withdraw from the University
steps: Write to the Registrar through your Head of Department, stating your intention to withdraw and the effective date.
Have the letter endorsed by your Head of Department.
Obtain clearance from the Library, your hall of residence and the Finance Directorate.
Submit the endorsed letter and clearance form to the Academic Affairs Directorate.
Collect written acknowledgement for your records.
services.synthetic_note: Procedure authored by the project team. No published University source was found for it. Shown to students with a synthetic-source badge.
services.caveat: Consider deferment first if the difficulty is temporary — withdrawal ends studentship and returning means reapplying for admission.

services.name: Get or replace a student ID card
steps: Complete online registration on MIS Web — card production is triggered by a completed registration.
Attend the biometric capture session for your college, bringing your admission letter and a national ID.
Collect the card from the issuing point for your college, normally within three weeks.
To replace a lost card: report the loss, pay the replacement charge at the Cash Office, and submit the receipt with a replacement request form.
services.turnaround: Around three weeks for a new card, two weeks for a replacement
services.synthetic_note: Procedure authored by the project team. No published University source was found for it. Shown to students with a synthetic-source badge.
services.caveat: The GH₵50 replacement charge in this prototype is an illustrative placeholder chosen by the project team, not an official University fee.

services.name: Graduation and congregation
steps: Confirm on MIS Web at the end of your final semester that no grade is missing or incomplete.
Raise any missing grade with your department immediately, through the change of grade process.
Obtain financial clearance from the Finance Directorate.
Complete library and hall clearance.
Confirm your name appears on the provisional graduation list published by your department.
services.synthetic_note: Procedure authored by the project team. No published University source was found for it. Shown to students with a synthetic-source badge.
services.caveat: A student with outstanding fees may be left off the congregation list even when the academic requirements are met.

services.name: Find course information for a UGBS programme
steps: Check the course description in the College of Humanities student handbook, UGBS section.
Credit and programme requirements for your degree are set out in the same handbook.
For advice specific to your situation, contact your department in the Business School.
services.caveat: The indexed handbook is dated 2017, so confirm current requirements with your department.

services.name: Check examination results
steps: Log in to MIS Web with your student credentials.
Open your academic record to view results for the semester.
If a result is missing or looks wrong, the correction is raised by the teaching department using the change of grade process.

services.name: Find the right student support service
services.channel: Dean of Student Affairs and specialist units
steps: For personal, emotional or mental health difficulty, contact the University Counselling Centre, and tell your academic advisor if it is affecting your work.
For hall accommodation problems, start with the Hall Administration or Senior Tutor.
For financial hardship, approach the Students Financial Aid Office before the registration deadline, and put any payment arrangement with the Finance Directorate in writing.
For illness, use the University Hospital — its medical report is the supporting document other procedures ask for.
For harassment, discrimination or misconduct, report to the Dean of Student Affairs.
If you are unsure which applies, the Dean of Student Affairs is the general entry point and will refer you onward.
services.synthetic_note: Routing guide authored by the project team; no consolidated published guide was found.
